name: Desert dunes
desc: Crossing, exhaustion, being very small - nothing in any direction to measure yourself against.
tags: scenery, no humans, sand dunes, wind ripples in sand, sharp dune crest, long shadows in troughs, blowing sand, distant dune ridges, cloudless sky, single line of footprints
prose: rolling sand dunes with fine wind ripples across their faces, a knife-sharp crest catching the light, long shadows lying in the troughs and ridge after ridge fading into the distance
note: Comes out a flat beige field with no read on size. Scale lives in the ripple texture and the receding ridge lines, plus one small thing for comparison - footprints, a track, a lone figure. The word desert alone drags in cacti and saguaro from the American southwest, so say dunes and sand sea and never just desert. heat_haze gives the glare but not the shimmer, per that look note.
